title: Raspberry cream mimosa
steps: Prepare the raspberry cream: In a small saucepan, thaw frozen raspberries on medium heat until they've broken down and become soup-like. Add sugar to the saucepan, stirring until it dissolves. Remove from heat. Filter through a sieve to remove the raspberry seeds. Add the cream, stir, and chill. This raspberry cream can be prepared in advance and frozen.
Mix the raspberry cream with the sparkling wine and top with fresh raspberries.
